headline: Capcom is preparing for a ‘future where we create games together with AI’
summary: Capcom is embracing AI for future game development. Programmer Satoshi Ishida presented on the 'REX Project'. The studio aims to evolve its RE Engine with AI integration.

headline: The best early October Prime Day deals happening now
summary: Amazon is offering early Prime Big Deal Day discounts. Sales include Amazon hardware and other popular products. Official October Prime Day runs from October 6th to 8th.

headline: Splice CEO Kakul Srivastava thinks AI emails are killing conversations
summary: Splice CEO Kakul Srivastava believes AI-generated emails hinder real conversations. Splice is a popular platform for music samples used in hit songs. Srivastava previously held executive roles before leading Splice.

headline: An OpenAI safety employee has quit and is sounding the alarm
summary: An OpenAI safety employee, David Robinson, has resigned. Robinson is now publicly expressing concerns in The Atlantic. He previously authored safety reports for OpenAI's major model releases.

headline: Avengers: Doomsday Poster Highlights Doctor Doom and 3 Latverian Witches
summary: Marvel Studios released a new Avengers: Doomsday poster. The poster features Doctor Doom in a prominent role. Three Latverian witches will accompany Doctor Doom.

headline: Inde Navarrette Teases X-Men Role, Says She's 'Doing Everything Humanly Possible' to Do Rogue Justice
summary: Inde Navarrette discussed her role as Rogue in X-Men. She is committed to doing the character justice. Navarrette aims to put in maximum effort for the iconic role.

headline: Everything We Saw at RuneFest 2026, Including RuneScape 4 and RuneScape Reignited
summary: RuneFest 2026 showcased major announcements for RuneScape. Details on RuneScape 4 were revealed at the event. RuneScape Reignited was also a highlight of Jagex's presentation.

headline: Fourth RuneScape MMO Built With Unreal Engine in the Works, Jagex Announces RuneScape Animation With MoistCr1TiKaL
summary: Jagex announced a fourth RuneScape MMO is in development using Unreal Engine. An animated RuneScape adaptation is also planned. YouTube personality MoistCr1TiKaL is involved in the animation project.

headline: Flydubai co-pilot attacked captain with axe, UAE official says
summary: A Flydubai co-pilot allegedly attacked the captain with an axe. The incident occurred on an Israel-bound jet. The accused man has been identified as Hamam al-Hammami.

headline: Tories pledge to scrap £100,000 childcare 'cliff edge'
summary: The Conservative party plans to eliminate the £100,000 childcare 'cliff edge'. Leader Kemi Badenoch aims to prevent high earners from being penalized. The pledge is designed to support those who work harder.

headline: UK-Iranian dual national arrested over RAF Fairford released on bail
summary: A UK-Iranian dual national was arrested regarding RAF Fairford. The 25-year-old man has since been released on bail. He was initially apprehended in Westminster, London.

headline: Tennessee prison chief to resign after Christa Pike's failed execution
summary: Tennessee's prison chief will resign following Christa Pike's botched execution. Pike is in critical condition after surviving two lethal injections. Her lawyers argue the failure extends beyond a single individual.
